# YourDictionary

> YourDictionary is a comprehensive English language reference platform offering dictionary definitions, thesaurus lookups, grammar guides, and word game solvers.

YourDictionary provides authoritative definitions from Webster's and American Heritage Dictionary sources, alongside practical tools for word games like Scrabble, Words With Friends, Wordle, and Wordscapes. The platform combines traditional lexicography with modern word-finding utilities for both language learning and gaming.

## Key Topics

- Dictionary Definitions
- Thesaurus & Synonyms
- Grammar Guide
- Word Finder
- Scrabble
- Words With Friends
- Wordle
- Vocabulary
- Parts of Speech
- Sentence Examples
- Word Unscrambler
- Anagram Solver
- Writing Tips
- Language Learning
- Wordscapes

## Core Dictionary & Reference

- [Dictionary Definitions](https://www.yourdictionary.com/dictionary-definitions): Main dictionary definitions from Webster's and American Heritage sources
- [Free Thesaurus | Synonyms & Antonyms](https://thesaurus.yourdictionary.com): Thesaurus with synonyms and antonyms from Webster's Roget's
- [Sentence Examples | Examples of Words Used in a Sentence](https://sentence.yourdictionary.com): Sentence examples and word usage demonstrations for English

## Word Game Solvers & Tools

- [Word Finder | Scrabble Cheat & Word Game Helper](https://wordfinder.yourdictionary.com): Word Finder tool for Scrabble, Words With Friends, and Wordle
- [Wordle Solver & Letter Finder - Get Help on Today's Puzzle](https://wordfinder.yourdictionary.com/wordle): Wordle solver and daily puzzle helper tool
- [Words With Friends Cheat and Helper | WordFinder®](https://wordfinder.yourdictionary.com/words-with-friends-cheat): Words With Friends word finder and cheat helper tool
- [Word Unscrambler - Make Words With Letters](https://wordfinder.yourdictionary.com/unscramble): Word unscrambler for Scrabble and Words With Friends games
- [Anagram Solver - Decode & Find All Solutions | WordFinder®](https://wordfinder.yourdictionary.com/anagram-solver): Anagram solver for word games and letter rearrangement
- [Scrabble Word Checker & Dictionary | Check Playable Words](https://wordfinder.yourdictionary.com/scrabble-dictionary): Scrabble dictionary and word validator with point values
- [Wordscapes Cheat and Answers by WordFinder](https://wordscapes.yourdictionary.com): Wordscapes game cheats, answers, and level guides

## Grammar & Language Guides

- [Grammar | YourDictionary](https://www.yourdictionary.com/articles/grammar): Grammar guide covering parts of speech, punctuation, and language rules
- [Adjectives | YourDictionary](https://www.yourdictionary.com/articles/adjectives): Adjectives guide covering types, lists, and parts of speech
- [How to Order Adjectives in a Sentence | YourDictionary](https://www.yourdictionary.com/articles/cumulative-adjectives): Guide to ordering cumulative adjectives with examples and charts
- [How and When To Use Parentheses ( ) | YourDictionary](https://www.yourdictionary.com/articles/when-how-use-parentheses): Punctuation guide on proper parentheses usage and grammar rules

## Vocabulary & Writing Resources

- [Vocabulary | YourDictionary](https://www.yourdictionary.com/articles/vocabulary): Vocabulary guide with etymology, slang history, and word comparisons
- [Usage | YourDictionary](https://www.yourdictionary.com/articles/usage): Language reference for word meanings, usage tips, and cultural terms
- [Reading & Writing | YourDictionary](https://www.yourdictionary.com/articles/reading-writing): Writing guides covering literary devices, grammar, and creative writing
